audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-4 disagreed between layers: content win[1..4]=Katarina (matching packet.levelChart exactly) while full phases[1..4].side all read "Skill". Row 0 (Skill) and rows 5-6 (Azir) already agreed.
audit.why: Katarina's early kit is entirely free: Bouncing Blade and Shunpo cost 0 mana while every soldier costs you 40 down to 20, and Shunpo's 12s at rank 1 falls to 8s while your only escape is 22s falling to 16s. She sets the tempo from level 2 until your Nashor's Tooth.
audit.corrected: phases[1..4].side -> Katarina, ratings 5/10 and 6/10 -> 4/10 on those four rows, and all four whys rewritten to state Katarina winning.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was described as Azir's (phases[4].why: 'Emperor's Divide online — the dive insurance and the insec flip'), which contradicts win[4]=Katarina and the packet chart.
audit.why: Death Lotus arrives at 6 on 75s at rank 1; Emperor's Divide arrives at 6 on 120s. She gets roughly two ultimates to your one through that stretch. Your R is still the answer to hers, but the row belongs to her.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and whys[4] now state the 75s-vs-120s gap; breakdown.spikes rewritten around Death Lotus at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated, and two claims were factually wrong. spikes[1].text and content mid both called Death Lotus 'a global execute threat on low-health targets across the map'. It is a 550-range channel around herself. spikes[0].text and whys[5] credited the reset mechanic to Death Lotus; the resets come from Voracity.
audit.why: Death Lotus carries the channel flag — 'interruptible, any CC cancels it' — and Emperor's Divide is a knockback. Your R is the single button in your kit that ends her ultimate, which makes 'hold R for her channel' the whole matchup. Separately, Death Lotus applies healing reduction, and Voracity dramatically reduces her remaining cooldowns whenever a champion she recently damaged dies — that is the map-wide snowball the old text misattributed to the ult.
audit.corrected: R-breaks-the-channel written into tldr, winCon, ahead, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.late, dosFull[2], report[9].t, report[11].t and content mid/late. Death Lotus described accurately with its 550 range, 75s cooldown and Grievous Wounds.

notes: CHART: rows 1-4 were disagreeing across layers (win[]=Katarina, phases[].side=Skill). I moved the full layer onto the content/packet verdict and rewrote all four whys plus their ratings in the same proposal; no win[N] edit is needed because win[N] already holds the target value. Rows 0 (Skill) and 5-6 (Azir) already agreed and were left alone. TWO FACTUAL ERRORS KILLED: Death Lotus was described in two places as a global execute across the map — it is a 550-range channel around herself on 75/60/45; and the reset mechanic was credited to the ultimate in three places when it belongs to Voracity, the passive. Both were the kind of claim a reader would act on and lose the game to. FLAG MISFIRE: Bouncing Blade carries a 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes' derived flag, but Riot's own text for it describes only a bouncing dagger. Per the rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about grounding — if that flag is real it would matter enormously here, because grounding would deny your E, so it is worth a human check. dosFull[2].d also carried a wrong number ('fifteen-second' Shunpo); Shunpo is 12/11/10/9/8.
